row: One On One Physical Therapy and Sports Rehabilitation strives to provide the absolute best in patient healthcare and service. We pride ourselves in delivering our best each day and in achieving optimal results. Each patient receives a thorough rehabilitation program customized to meet their individual needs and goals. No two people are the same, therefore their treatment program shouldn't be either. At One on One we ask you to expect more from physical therapy. Our professionals specialize in assessing human movement and body mechanics. We don't just treat the symptoms, we find the cause of the problem. We help you Reclaim your Life!
